docs.appDesc: Visual open-source API builder. Define datasets, design endpoints and generate production-ready code for FastAPI, Express or NestJS.
docs.datasetsDesc: Define schemas with types, relationships and sample data. Import from CSV, Excel or external database.
docs.restEndpointsDesc: Auto CRUD + custom routes linked to datasets. GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.
docs.codeGenerationDesc: Production-ready bundle with models, controllers, security, Docker and SDKs in TypeScript and Python.
docs.mockServerDesc: Simulate your API in real time with persistent database data, filters and authentication.
docs.cliDeployDesc: Deploy your API to any server with a single command. Export, serve or deploy via SSH without depending on the UI.
docs.shareLinksDesc: Read-only snapshots with password and expiration. Share your documented API without exposing the editor.
docs.modelsDesc: Define datasets with types, validations and relationships. Translated to SQLModel, Sequelize or TypeORM depending on the stack.
docs.controllersDesc: REST endpoints with full CRUD and custom routes. Dynamic {id} parameters and direct dataset binding.
docs.securityDesc: JWT with access tokens (24h) and refresh (7 days). Optional API Key. Configurable rate limiting.
docs.deployDesc: Multi-stage Docker Compose, auto-seeds, health checks and CI/CD included in the generated bundle.
docs.tutorialDesc: Create your first API in 10 steps. Practical example: bank user API.
docs.tutorialStep1Desc: Run the installer from the terminal. You will set up the admin credentials and choose your database during installation:
docs.tutorialStep2Desc: Start the backend and frontend services. You can use Docker Compose (recommended) or run them separately:
docs.tutorialStep3Desc: Open http://localhost:5173 and log in with the credentials you created during installation.
docs.tutorialStep4Desc: Set name, description and technology stack from the Editor panel.
docs.tutorialStep5Desc: Go to the "Datasets" tab and add your model fields. You can import from CSV, Excel or an external DB:
docs.tutorialStep6Desc: In the "Endpoints" tab, add the REST routes. Each endpoint links to a dataset:
docs.tutorialStep7Desc: In the "Simulator" tab, launch the mock server and test your endpoints with realistic auto-generated data.
docs.tutorialStep8Desc: Choose authentication (JWT, API Key), rate limiting and configure secrets. Everything is included in the generated code.
docs.tutorialStep9Desc: Click "Save & launch API" to sync with the backend and get the sandbox URL, Redoc docs and share link.
docs.tutorialStep10Desc: In the "Generated API" tab you will find the .zip bundle with production-ready code: models, controllers, Docker, seeds, tests and SDKs.
docs.tutorialStep11Desc: Use the CLI, Docker or your favorite platform to put your API in production.
docs.cliSubtitle: The command-line interface lets you deploy, serve and export DoApi projects from any environment, without depending on the graphical UI.
docs.cliInstallDesc: The CLI is included in the doapi-backend package.
docs.cliDeploySubtitle: Deploys an exported project as a standalone API. Reads the JSON, creates the DB, imports data and starts the server.
docs.cliServeSubtitle: Serves an existing project from the builder DB as a standalone API on a separate port.
docs.cliInitSubtitle: Exports a project from the DB to JSON for deploying with doapi deploy.
docs.sshDesc: Deploy directly to a VPS via SSH + Docker. The CLI copies the file, generates docker-compose and starts the containers.
docs.codeExamplesDesc: Examples in multiple languages for consuming your API. Endpoints are dynamically generated from your project.
docs.deploySubtitle: All the ways to take your API to production.
docs.deployCliDesc: Deploy your exported API with a single command. The CLI creates the database, imports project data and starts the server with clean URLs. No Docker or configuration needed.
docs.deployDockerDesc: The generated bundle includes a production-ready Dockerfile. Build the image and run the container on any server with Docker installed.
docs.deployComposeDesc: The bundle includes docker-compose.yml with API + PostgreSQL configured. The most complete option for production environments.
docs.deployRailwayDesc: Railway auto-detects the project. The bundle includes deploy/railway.json with the configuration. Connect your GitHub repo and Railway deploys it automatically.
docs.deployRenderDesc: Render deploys from GitHub. The bundle includes deploy/render.yaml with the service configuration. Push the project to GitHub and connect it from the Render dashboard.
docs.deployCicdDesc: Automate deployment to your VPS on push to main. The bundle includes a workflow in .github/workflows/deploy.yml that connects via SSH and runs docker compose.
docs.deploySshDesc: Use doapi deploy --ssh to deploy directly to any VPS with Docker. The CLI copies the file, generates docker-compose and starts the containers automatically.
docs.deployVpsDesc: Direct installation on your server. For FastAPI you need Python 3.11+, for Express/NestJS you need Node.js 18+.
docs.checklistDb: Database: Use persistent PostgreSQL instead of SQLite.
docs.checklistSecurity: Security: Change secret keys in the .env file.
docs.checklistHttps: HTTPS: Required in production. Use Certbot or Cloudflare.
docs.checklistCors: CORS: Restrict allowed origins in production.
docs.checklistSdk: SDK: Bundles include TypeScript and Python clients in sdks/.

info.title: DoApi
info.subtitle: Visual open-source API builder. Define datasets, design endpoints and generate production-ready code for FastAPI, Express or NestJS.
info.datasetsDesc: Define schemas with types, relationships, sample data and automatic Faker generation. Import from CSV, Excel or external database.
info.restEndpointsDesc: Auto CRUD + custom routes linked to datasets. GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE methods.
info.codeGenerationDesc: Production-ready bundle with models, controllers, security, Docker and SDK in TypeScript and Python.
info.mockServerDesc: Simulate your API in real time with test data, filters and authentication. Ideal for frontends and demos.
info.shareLinksDesc: Read-only snapshots with password and expiration. Share your documented API without exposing the editor.
info.webhooksDesc: Notify external URLs when data changes in the mock server. Create, update and delete events.
info.versioningDesc: Project change history. Create snapshots, compare versions and restore previous states.
info.mappingsDesc: Visual field-to-field relationships between datasets. Direct transformations, type casting, concatenation and formatting.
info.dockerDesc: Multi-stage Docker Compose with health checks and auto-seeds included in every generated bundle.
info.openapiDesc: Automatic Redoc documentation and OpenAPI 3.1 spec for each project. Compatible with Postman and Swagger.
info.securityDesc: JWT, API Key, rate limiting and rotatable credentials. Built-in protection from the configuration panel.
info.proStartDesc: Install with ./install.sh and start with ./start.sh. Automatic port management and unified logs with a single command.
info.externalDbDesc: Connect existing PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite databases. Introspect schemas and auto-generate datasets.
info.fastapiDesc: SQLAlchemy, Pydantic v2, JWT, rate limiting, multi-stage Docker, auto-seeds, OpenAPI 3.1.
info.expressDesc: Sequelize ORM, auto-Swagger, JWT, rate limiting, Docker Compose with PostgreSQL.
info.nestjsDesc: TypeORM, Swagger decorators, AuthGuard, typed DTOs, modular enterprise structure, Docker.
info.installDesc: Run ./install.sh to configure and ./start.sh to start Backend and Frontend unified.
info.createDatasetDesc: Define fields with types, validations and sample data. Use Faker for realistic data generation.
info.designEndpointsDesc: Generate CRUD routes linked to your datasets or create custom endpoints with your own methods and paths.
info.testSimulatorDesc: Launch the mock server and test your endpoints live with realistic data. No backend needed.
info.generateDeployDesc: Click "Save & launch API", download the .zip bundle with production-ready code and deploy anywhere.
security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Configure authentication, generate credentials and test your API security.
security.authMethodDesc: Define how clients will authenticate when consuming your API {{name}}.
security.testAuthDesc: Send a test request to the mock server with the current configuration.
security.checklistNote: Reference checklist. In production, follow the framework's security guides.
security.generatedCodeDesc: The bundle includes authentication middleware based on the chosen method: API Key validation or JWT verification with the configured secret. Rate limiting implemented with middleware.
security.mockServerDesc: The simulator respects the security configuration. Mock routes require the same credentials as the generated API, allowing you to test authentication before deploying.
security.recommendationsDesc: Use HTTPS in production. Generate unique keys per project. Do not share JWT secrets. Rate limiting protects against abuse. CORS restricted to known origins.
securityConfig.apiKeyHint: Clients must send this key in the X-API-Key header.
securityConfig.jwtHint: Secret used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token> header.
securityConfig.rateLimitHint: Leave empty or set to 0 to disable the limit.
securityOptions.title: Recommended security options
securityOptions.option1: Protect the backend behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS (Nginx, Caddy or Cloudflare).
securityOptions.option2: Set environment variables like DOAPI_BUILDER_TOKEN and share them only with your team.
securityOptions.option3: Add basic auth or JWT to the /api/<projectId> routes if exposing sensitive data.
securityOptions.option4: Restrict IPs that can access the builder; your consumers only need the /api and /projects/{id}/docs routes.

cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000

# Terminal 2 - Frontend:
cd frontend && npm run dev
